title: How to Make a DIY Air Filter | Ask This Old House
summary: This Old House's Ross Trethewey explains MERV filter ratings and how air filtration works, then shows how to build a localized DIY air filter, including a box fan with multiple filters.
why: HN recommends it as a practical breakdown of filtration versus air volume and a clever box-fan filter design.

quote.text: This Old House has a really good breakdown on filtration and air volume and have a pretty clever DIY box fan approach using multiple filters.
